options.name: access_key
options.description: The access key required to authenticate with the Tenable.io API. This key can be set as an environment variable named TENABLE_ACCESS_KEY or passed directly to the module.

options.name: alt_targets
options.description: If you include this parameter, Tenable Vulnerability Management scans these targets instead of the default. Value can be an array where each index is a target, or an array with a single index of comma-separated targets.

options.name: rollover
options.description: Indicates whether or not to launch a rollover scan instead of full scan. A rollover scan only runs against the targets that Tenable Vulnerability Management did not scan due to a previous scan timeout.

options.name: scan_id
options.description: The unique identifier of the scan. The name starts with 'template-...'. This identifier can be either the scans.schedule_uuid or the scans.id using list_scans module. Tenable recommends that you use scans.schedule_uuid.

options.name: secret_key
options.description: The secret key required to authenticate with the Tenable.io API. This key can be set as an environment variable named TENABLE_SECRET_KEY or passed directly to the module.
